verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair axis for an observability platform with REST APIs, but the evidence never shows one. The ES|QL REST docs only describe request parameters, with no interactive console or runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and llms.txt and markdown docs are adjacent AI-readable documentation, not an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
